data.name: Bhavna
data.gender_notes: Bhavna is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit bhāvanā, 'feeling, contemplation', from the root bhū, 'to be'. Its root is Sanskrit bhū (भू). A classical Sanskrit term for feeling. Bhavna is a Sanskrit name meaning “Feeling; emotion; contemplation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhavna expresses “Feeling; emotion; contemplation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit bhāvanā, 'feeling, contemplation', from the root bhū, 'to be'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhavna total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
